ideas.sourceConcept: Setting Up for Recording applied to building a minimal sketch that can survive on laptop speakers and headphones
ideas.prompt: Using Jake Perrine — Producing Music with Ableton Live, especially Setting Up for Recording, shape a Neon Orbit loop move around building a minimal sketch that can survive on laptop speakers and headphones. Keep it practical inside Ableton: start from a small clip or scene, make one deliberate edit, save the useful version, and avoid adding tracks just to feel productive. Ask: Is this sound earning its place, or is it only filling screen space?
